Business notes:

- Restaurant group with 3 brands: BurgerLab (burger restaurant), Café Aroma (café), Gelato Mar (ice cream kiosks).
- sales.total is the receipt amount in euros, VAT included. Revenue = SUM(sales.total).
- A sale_lines row has either product_id OR menu_id, never both.
- stock has either store_id OR warehouse_id (store stock vs warehouse stock).
- Stores receive ingredients through transfers from warehouses; warehouses buy from suppliers (purchases).
- purchases.status values: 'encomendada' (ordered) or 'recebida' (received).
- employees work either in a store (store_id) OR in a warehouse (warehouse_id).
- Data values (names, cities, categories) are in Portuguese.
- For cost, margin or profitability use the views product_margins and menu_margins (unit_cost, unit_margin, margin_pct per unit sold).
- Total margin of sales = sum(sale_lines.quantity * (sale_lines.unit_price - unit_cost)), joining product_margins on product_id or menu_margins on menu_id.
- For price recommendations, which products to promote or remove, use the view price_recommendations (classification: estrela, burro de carga, enigma, cão; recommendation text; last 90 days, compared within each brand).
- When the user says MB Way or MBWay, the payment_method value is 'mbway'.
- When filtering by a name (product, ingredient, store, brand), use ILIKE so case does not matter.

Q: Quantos menus vendeu cada loja da BurgerLab em 2026?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja, m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade
FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id
JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab' AND s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY st.name, m.name ORDER BY st.name, quantidade DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Que compras estão por receber?
SQL: SELECT p.id AS compra, su.name AS fornecedor, w.name AS armazem, p.ordered_at AS data_encomenda,
       ROUND(SUM(pl.quantity * pl.unit_cost), 2) AS valor
FROM purchases p JOIN suppliers su ON su.id = p.supplier_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = p.warehouse_id
JOIN purchase_lines pl ON pl.purchase_id = p.id
WHERE p.status = 'encomendada'
GROUP BY p.id, su.name, w.name, p.ordered_at ORDER BY p.ordered_at

How many purchases are still pending at the Armazém Centro warehouse?
SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS compras_por_receber FROM purchases p JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = p.warehouse_id WHERE w.name ILIKE 'Armazém Centro' AND p.status = 'encomendada'

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)

WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY talao_medio DESC

JOIN product_margins pm ON pm.product_id = sl.product_id

ORDER BY margem_total_euros DESC

GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id
JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab' AND s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY st.name, m.name ORDER BY st.name, quantidade DESC

ORDER BY margem_total_euros DESC
LIMIT 10

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Qual foi a faturação de cada marca em outubro de 2026?
SQL: SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Qual foi a faturação de cada marca em outubro de 2026?
SQL: SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'

  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados

WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Qual foi a faturação de cada marca em outubro de 2026?
SQL: SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

Q: Qual o talão médio por marca em 2026?

WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY talao_medio DESC

SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja, m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja, m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade
FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id
JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab' AND s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY st.name, m.name ORDER BY st.name, quantidade DESC

)

WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?

       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'

GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

Q: Qual o talão médio por marca em 2026?
SQL: SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(AVG(s.total), 2) AS talao_medio, COUNT(*) AS taloes
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY talao_medio DESC

GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Qual foi a faturação de cada marca em outubro de 2026?
SQL: SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

Q: Quantos menus vendeu cada loja da BurgerLab em 2026?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja, m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade

JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab' AND s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY st.name, m.name ORDER BY st.name, quantidade DESC

FROM stock s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = s.ingredient_id
WHERE s.store_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.quantity ASC LIMIT 20

Q: Quantos menus vendeu cada loja da BurgerLab em 2026?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja, m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade
FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id
JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab' AND s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY st.name, m.name ORDER BY st.name, quantidade DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Qual foi a faturação de cada marca em outubro de 2026?
SQL: SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

Q: Quantos menus vendeu cada loja da BurgerLab em 2026?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja, m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade
FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id

WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab' AND s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY st.name, m.name ORDER BY st.name, quantidade DESC

SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados

WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?

       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas

  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Quantos menus vendeu cada loja da BurgerLab em 2026?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja, m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade
FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id
JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab' AND s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY st.name, m.name ORDER BY st.name, quantidade DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

Q: Qual o talão médio por marca em 2026?
SQL: SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(AVG(s.total), 2) AS talao_medio, COUNT(*) AS taloes
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY talao_medio DESC

Q: Qual foi a faturação de cada marca em outubro de 2026?
SQL: SELECT b.name AS marca, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao
FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY faturacao DESC

Q: Quantos gelados vendeu cada loja em agosto de 2026?
SQL: WITH linhas AS (
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity AS qtd
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN products p ON p.id = sl.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sl.sale_id, sl.quantity * mi.quantity
  FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.menu_id = sl.menu_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = mi.product_id
  WHERE p.category = 'gelado'
)
SELECT st.name AS loja, SUM(l.qtd) AS gelados
FROM linhas l JOIN sales s ON s.id = l.sale_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY gelados DESC

SQL: SELECT s.payment_method AS metodo_pagamento, ROUND(SUM(s.total), 2) AS faturacao, COUNT(*) AS taloes
FROM sales s
WHERE s.sold_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY s.payment_method ORDER BY faturacao DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?

       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

Q: Quantas horas trabalharam os funcionários de cada loja na semana passada?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja,
       ROUND(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.end_time - sh.start_time)) / 3600), 1) AS horas
FROM shifts sh JOIN employees e ON e.id = sh.employee_id JOIN stores st ON st.id = e.store_id
WHERE sh.shift_date >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND sh.shift_date <  date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY horas DESC

Q: Quantos menus vendeu cada loja da BurgerLab em 2026?
SQL: SELECT st.name AS loja, m.name AS menu, SUM(sl.quantity) AS quantidade
FROM sale_lines sl JOIN menus m ON m.id = sl.menu_id JOIN sales s ON s.id = sl.sale_id
JOIN stores st ON st.id = s.store_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = st.brand_id
WHERE b.name = 'BurgerLab' AND s.sold_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND s.sold_at < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY st.name, m.name ORDER BY st.name, quantidade DESC
